git_commits.content: Refactored session caching. Replaced Redis cluster with local Dragonfly instance due to memory overhead in VPC. Verified in staging.

slack_dump.content: Heads up: Dragonfly memory leak bug observed during staging load test. Rolling back to Redis until v1.2 patch lands. Do not use Dragonfly for now.
